Class TriggerHandler

public virtual class TriggerHandler

Known derived/implementing types:
AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler, AccountTriggerHandler, AdjustmentTriggerHandler, AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandler, BankAccountTriggerHandler, BillAdjustmentTriggerHandler, BillCollectionTriggerHandler, BillCommissionTriggerHandler, BillPaymentTriggerHandler, BillTriggerHandler, CaseTriggerHandler, CollectionInvoiceTriggerHandler, CommissionPaymentTriggerHandler, ComponentTriggerHandler, ContactTriggerHandler, DatedConversionRateTriggerHandler, EmailMessageTriggerHandler, ErrorLogEventSubscriberHandler, InvoiceTriggerHandler, LeadTriggerHandler, Payment2TriggerHandler, ProductTypeTriggerHandler, StripeReferenceTriggerHandler, StripeTransactionTriggerHandler, SubscriptionPeriodTriggerHandler, SubscriptionTriggerHandler, TriggerHandlerTest.TestHandler

Trigger framework base class that provides context-specific methods automatically called when a trigger is executed. Handlers extend this class to implement trigger logic. Based on Kevin O'Hara's trigger framework (https://github.com/kevinohara80/sfdc-trigger-framework). Features include: context routing, loop count management, bypass mechanisms, method enable/disable via TriggerHandlerSettings__c and TriggerSettings__mdt, field change detection utilities, and first-run tracking.
